description: This file defines the Input class for the typeahead.js library, handling user input, event management, and accessibility features.

classes.name: Input
classes.description: A class managing user input interactions for the typeahead component, including event handling, query management, and accessibility.

methods.name: normalizeQuery
methods.description: Static method to normalize query strings by trimming leading whitespace and condensing internal whitespace.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds event handlers to the input element for focus, blur, keydown, and input events.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Sets focus to the input element.

methods.name: blur
methods.description: Removes focus from the input element.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Sets the query string and updates the input value.

methods.name: hasQueryChangedSinceLastFocus
methods.description: Checks if the query has changed since the input last received focus.

methods.name: getInputValue
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of the input element.

methods.name: setInputValue
methods.description: Sets the value of the input element.

methods.name: resetInputValue
methods.description: Resets the input value to the current query.

methods.name: clearHintIfInvalid
methods.description: Clears the hint if it is invalid based on the current input value.

methods.name: hasFocus
methods.description: Checks if the input element currently has focus.

methods.name: hasOverflow
methods.description: Determines if the input's content overflows its visible area.

methods.name: isCursorAtEnd
methods.description: Checks if the cursor is at the end of the input value.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes event handlers and cleans up helper elements.
